items.question: ...I don't know how to use Discord?
items.answer: No problem, you don't need to know much about Discord. Discly understands it should set up servers — all you need to do is tell it what you want on your server. You'll see a complete tutorial in your dashboard.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Have questions? We have answers. Find everything you need to know about the bot.

items.question: How does the bot work?
items.answer: The bot uses AI to analyze what you asked for, then performs the necessary actions to achieve your goal. There are two commands: one specifically for editing your server (making changes to an existing server), and another for creating a server from scratch.

items.question: Will I have instant access to the bot?
items.answer: Yes, you'll have instant access to the bot after purchase. You'll receive an email with the access link and will be able to set up your server in seconds.

items.question: Do I need Discord experience to use the bot?
items.answer: No! The bot is designed for users of all experience levels. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced user, our AI handles the complex setup while you focus on your community. We also provide a complete tutorial in your dashboard.

items.question: Is the bot safe?
items.answer: Yes, the bot is safe. It's developed with best security practices and tested to ensure there are no issues.

items.question: Can I modify the server after the bot sets it up?
items.answer: Yes! You can modify the server manually or use the specific Discly command to edit your server and tell it what you want changed.

items.question: What if the AI doesn't set it up exactly as I want?
items.answer: Since AI can interpret requests incorrectly, we offer unlimited re-configurations at no extra cost. Simply provide more specific instructions or adjustments, and the bot will adjust your server accordingly.

items.question: Is customer support available?
items.answer: Yes! We offer 24/7 customer support through a contact form in your dashboard. Our team responds quickly to help resolve any issues or answer questions about using the bot or setting up your server.

items.question: How long does it take to set up a server?
items.answer: Using Discly, it takes just a few seconds. Doing it manually might take a few hours.

items.question: Is there any limit on server size or number of features?
items.answer: No! The bot works with servers of any size and can configure all standard Discord features including roles, channels, categories, permissions, and specific channel settings. The AI adapts to your specific needs, regardless of server complexity.

items.question: Can I request a refund?
items.answer: Yes. Within a 7-day period after purchase, you can request a refund.
